principle: Meta Ad Library searches live ad copy and advertisers, not design inspiration descriptions.

queryTiers.purpose: Collect stable real campaign creatives from known advertisers.
Collect category and benefit messaging patterns.
Collect sale, CTA, benefit hierarchy, and retail promotion structures.
Check whether the brand currently has searchable Meta ads.

product_visual.label: 클린 제품 비주얼
product_visual.rule: Qwen creative_type=clean_product_visual, product_focus>=70, text_density<=40, no carousel or video

single_image_ad.label: 단일 광고 이미지
single_image_ad.rule: Exclude carousel and video, but text-heavy price ads may remain

brand_campaign.label: 브랜드 캠페인
brand_campaign.rule: Keep up to 3 images per ad

promotion_structure.label: 프로모션 구조
promotion_structure.rule: Keep up to 5 images per ad for offer, CTA, and hierarchy reference
